summary: Sewain full-stack test: backend 28/28 pytest passing, frontend UI verified end-to-end. Auth (demo + email login + register), Today dashboard, Unit CRUD + filters + AI matches, Leads flow + deal->tenant conversion, Tenants + payments (mark paid, AI reminder draft), Maintenance AI classify + start/resolve, Killer AI import-chat (real GPT extracted 6 leads correctly), Tanya Sewain (real GPT answered with live tenant data), Impact, Settings — all working. AI calls returned in 15-45s. Dark UI is polished and Indonesian copy renders correctly. Missing testIDs on many interactive elements (see action_items).

issues: Works correctly and looks polished; no visible layout issues on 390x844 viewport

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: appears on every page (likely in a shared component/library). Non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Add missing testIDs on Today screen: ai-summary, beresin-satu-satu, stat-card-followups, stat-card-viewings, stat-card-payments, stat-card-maintenance, action-queue, queue-item-payment, queue-item-viewing, queue-item-followup, queue-item-maintenance, mark-paid-button, confirm-viewing-button, open-followup-button, open-reminder-button, resolve-maintenance-button.

Add filter chip testIDs on Units/Leads/Maintenance/Tenants tabs: filter-semua, filter-kosong, filter-terisi, filter-reserved, filter-maintenance, and lead/tenant/maintenance equivalents. Add unit-card / lead-card / tenant-card testIDs.
Address React Native Web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by migrating pointerEvents from prop to style (usually in TouchableOpacity/Pressable/View usage or a wrapper component).

Consider allowing partial updates on PUT /api/units/{uid} (currently requires full UnitIn body — returns 422 for partial payloads). Not a blocker since the frontend sends the full unit on update, but a PATCH-style endpoint would be more resilient.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend structure is clean: routers split by domain (auth, main, ai). AI service uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY correctly.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded from API responses (verified via /api/units, /api/leads, /api/tenants, etc.).
AI features (analyze-chat, remind-draft, maintenance classify, tanya, unit matches, today summary) all return real GPT outputs; no mocks detected.
Seed data is comprehensive (2 properties, 12 units, 5 leads, 4 tenants, payments, 2 maintenance) and fresh demo accounts get a full data set.
